t: The Guerrilla War for Your Desktop: Google, OpenAI, and the Battle for Local AI
s: This article chronicles the emerging battle for local AI dominance, focusing on Google's efficient Gemma models and OpenAI's new open-source gpt-oss, highlighting their impact on inference engines like Ollama and LM Studio, and the competition for user adoption on personal hardware.
sub: Local AI inference engines (Ollama, LM Studio) and their reliance on llama.cpp.
Google's lightweight Gemma models vs. OpenAI's larger gpt-oss impacting performance on home hardware.
The strategic partnership between OpenAI and Ollama, including default model changes and UI integration.
Georgi Gerganov's foundational work with GGML and llama.cpp enabling local AI on consumer hardware.
